title: What is Impulse?
text: Impulse (J) is defined as the product of force and the time interval over which it acts: J = FΔt. Its unit is N·s.

title: Impulse-Momentum Theorem
text: The impulse-momentum theorem states: Impulse = Change in momentum. So FΔt = Δp = mv_f - mv_i.

title: Direction Matters
text: The ball reverses direction. If initial velocity is +30 m/s, final velocity is -40 m/s (or vice versa). The change in velocity is significant!
